statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Delayed NQ/MNQ evidence remains two-way and does not verify persistent mean-reversion failure.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON; Tail remains below the block threshold before the cash-open and PMI checkpoint.
headline: Low Tail, extreme Stress; the cash-open and PMI cluster remains the main conditional path-risk window.
body: Delayed public NQ/MNQ quotes remain inside the overnight range and materially below the session high rather than pinned to an extreme. Event density rises into the U.S. cash open and Flash PMI, while oil and rates remain important cross-asset inputs.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 clock-hours, Tail was usually low, briefly reaching 27% around the prior U.S. open before falling back below WATCH; Stress remained high to extreme.
outlookSummary: Base-case Tail remains low outside the 13:30-15:30 UTC open/PMI/Fed/EIA cluster. Escalation requires observed persistent direction, shallow or failed retracements, repeated extension, or a coherent delayed second leg.

forecast.analysis: Delayed public NQ/MNQ quotes remain inside the overnight range rather than pinned to an extreme. The observed retreat from the session high and repeated movement through the range do not verify persistent one-way or no-mean-reversion structure.
drivers: Delayed NQ remains inside the overnight range

forecast.analysis: Post-PMI price discovery overlaps Governor Barr at 14:05 UTC and EIA at 14:30 UTC. Elevated Tail requires a coherent second directional leg or continued mean-reversion failure rather than event importance alone.
After the main release cluster, Tail falls to WATCH if two-way trade returns. A delayed extension sequence or repeated failed retracements would keep path risk above the low band.

forecast.analysis: Late U.S. morning risk remains WATCH if an earlier directional move still resists meaningful retracement. Normal counter-moves and fading cross-asset alignment would support further normalization.
drivers: Quality of counter-moves after the event cluster
Rates and oil as confirmation or conflict

forecast.analysis: Midday Tail remains WATCH only if directional efficiency persists through lunch. Broader rotation with repeated retracements would keep conditions difficult but more mean-reverting.
drivers: Breadth and semiconductor alignment if independently confirmed

forecast.analysis: Early afternoon Tail returns to low unless the session is still holding near an extreme with weak counter-moves. Repeated rotation would argue against persistent path failure.
drivers: Retracement quality after the morning catalyst stack

forecast.analysis: Mid-afternoon risk is low in the base case. A renewed directional expansion would require fresh confirmation from price-path persistence rather than earlier event volatility.
drivers: Cross-asset confirmation if a new move develops

forecast.analysis: Into the later afternoon, Stress remains high but Tail stays low unless a one-way move re-accelerates and retracements continue to fail.
drivers: Rates and oil as secondary confirmation

forecast.analysis: Approaching power hour, Tail remains low in the base case. A fresh break that holds an extreme with shallow counter-moves would be the relevant conditional escalation.
drivers: Shallow counter-moves as the escalation trigger

forecast.analysis: Power-hour conditions are expected to normalize unless late-session directional efficiency strengthens. Tail remains low without repeated extension after failed retracements.
Near the cash close, Tail stays low if the session continues to rotate. A late unresolved second leg would be the main conditional exception.
Early Globex conditions are expected to be quieter. Tail remains low unless the U.S. close leaves an unresolved one-way structure that continues without meaningful retracement.
drivers: Globex handoff from the U.S. close
Persistence of any unresolved directional move

forecast.analysis: Overnight Asia hours carry low base-case Tail. Fresh geopolitical or rate shocks would mainly raise Stress unless accompanied by persistent directional NQ structure.
drivers: Persistent futures direction would be required for Tail escalation

forecast.analysis: Asian trade remains low-Tail in the base case. Semiconductor and megacap alignment would matter only if independent futures evidence also shows failed mean reversion.
drivers: Independent NQ path evidence remains decisive

forecast.analysis: Late Asia conditions remain low-Tail absent a new directional catalyst. Two-way trade would keep the regime closer to normal despite elevated macro uncertainty.
drivers: Absence of a fresh directional catalyst

forecast.analysis: Approaching Europe, Tail edges slightly higher only because cross-asset repricing can broaden. Escalation still requires persistent NQ direction and weak retracements.
drivers: NQ extreme holding would be required for higher Tail

forecast.analysis: European morning trade keeps low Tail in the base case. A synchronized move in rates, oil and technology would matter only if NQ also holds an extreme.
Europe-U.S. handoff risk increases modestly. Tail stays low unless premarket structure begins showing repeated extension and limited counter-moves.
drivers: Failed retracements would be the key escalation signal

forecast.analysis: During the European late morning, Tail remains low while Stress rises with U.S. data proximity. Premarket range behavior is the key conditional checkpoint.
Early U.S. premarket remains low-Tail unless a fresh directional break starts holding. Stress stays elevated as the next day's U.S. releases move closer.
Premarket path sensitivity increases modestly. Tail remains below WATCH unless the range resolves into persistent direction with shallow or failed retracements.
With the next U.S. data window approaching, Stress returns to extreme territory. Tail remains low unless pre-release positioning becomes one-way and resistant to retracement.
drivers: Mean-reversion quality remains decisive for Tail

forecast.analysis: The final forecast hour remains low-Tail but event-sensitive. A move toward WATCH would require observed pre-release directional efficiency, not the existence of scheduled data alone.
drivers: Scheduled data alone do not establish Tail
